cohort: 440 women with surgically confirmed endometriosis (cases) and 880 women without endometriosis (controls) in China.
finding: This case-control study found that not being breastfed as an infant, neonatal vaginal bleeding, and paternal smoking were associated with an increased risk of developing endometriosis later in life among Chinese women.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was probably associated with an increased risk of endometriosis, although the confidence interval included the null hypothesis value.
